text:
keisha: Quick PR to consolidate metering rollup examples + billing-preview export. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6120
keisha: Main asks: (1) show how minute-rollups feed monthly billing (tiny ASCII timeline), (2) clarify overage soft-cap vs hard-cap behavior, and (3) replace the old embeddings usage example that counted per-request instead of per-token.
ravi: on it. I'll add two PromQL queries for copy-paste: `sum(rate(redwood_tokens_consumed[1m])) by (customer, tier)` (live/minute view) and `sum(increase(redwood_tokens_consumed[30d])) by (customer)` (invoice window).
ravi: also added a note about dashboard template variables — use `$customer` and avoid hard `panelId` anchors for durable links.
maria: editorial: please add a very short paragraph defining "soft cap" behavior: when soft cap hit we emit alerts + apply graceful throttling (best-effort requests still flow), whereas hard cap triggers 429s or configured fallback routing. Link to runtime routing doc.
visuals: I uploaded a compact SVG timeline to the PR showing: minute buckets -> rollup -> 30d invoice. Also added a tiny mapping table for legacy tier names -> new tier names and fixed a broken relative link to `/examples/billing/export-sample.csv`.
keisha: For the SDK header snippet, propose the lightweight HTTP header form used in SDK-HTTP: `X-Redwood-Usage: acct=acct_52;units=200;metric=tokens` (semicolon-delimited). Add an editorial note: never include live API keys or account ids in public docs.
ravi: added a curl example with redacted key for the generate endpoint:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Usage: acct=acct_52;units=200;metric=tokens" \n  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the last commit"}'
```
keisha: Edge-case to call out: prefix/KV cache hits reduce billed tokens; only cache misses increment token counters. I added a single-sentence note in the usage section so support can point customers to it.
maria: Ops FYI: dashboard variable names and panel ids differ between prod/staging. Ops recommends linking to the dashboard slug (e.g., `/d/usage/overview`) and passing `?var-customer=$customer` if you need to preselect a tenant. OPS-1357 created to consider redirect for legacy anchors.
docs-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-6120--docs.redwood.ai — please confirm the CSV download and that the timeline renders in the preview.
keisha: I'll merge once @maria and @ravi give thumbs. Targeting EOD to coincide with the billing preview release. :thumbsup:
